privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how WearTry ("we", "us", "our") collects, uses, shares and protects your personal data when you visit our website or make a purchase, in accordance with the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), the UK GDPR, and applicable US state privacy laws.

sections.heading: 1. Who We Are
sections.body: WearTry is an online fashion retailer serving customers across the European Union, the United Kingdom and the United States. For any privacy-related questions, you can contact us at privacy@weartry.com.

sections.heading: 2. Information We Collect
sections.body: We collect information you provide directly (name, email, shipping and billing address, phone number, payment details processed by our payment provider), information collected automatically (IP address, browser type, device information, pages visited, cookies), and information from third parties (payment processors, delivery partners, marketing platforms).

sections.heading: 3. How We Use Your Information
sections.body: We use your data to process and deliver orders, provide customer support, personalise your shopping experience, send marketing communications where you have consented, prevent fraud, and comply with legal obligations.

sections.heading: 4. Legal Basis for Processing (EU/UK Users)
sections.body: We process personal data on the basis of contract performance (to fulfil your order), legitimate interest (to improve our services and prevent fraud), consent (for marketing communications and non-essential cookies), and legal obligation (tax and accounting records).

sections.heading: 5. Sharing Your Information
sections.body: We share data with payment processors, shipping and logistics partners, IT and hosting providers, and marketing tools, all under appropriate data processing agreements. We do not sell your personal data.

sections.heading: 6. International Data Transfers
sections.body: Where data is transferred outside the EU/UK/US, we rely on adequacy decisions or Standard Contractual Clauses to ensure an equivalent level of protection.

sections.heading: 7. Data Retention
sections.body: We retain personal data for as long as necessary to fulfil the purposes described in this policy, including legal, accounting and reporting requirements.

sections.heading: 8. Your Rights
sections.body: Depending on your location, you may have the right to access, correct, delete or port your data, object to or restrict processing, and withdraw consent at any time. EU and UK residents may also lodge a complaint with their local data protection authority.

sections.heading: 9. Cookies
sections.body: We use cookies and similar technologies as described in our Cookie Policy. You can manage your preferences at any time via our cookie settings.

sections.heading: 10. Children's Privacy
sections.body: Our kids' collection is intended for purchase by adults. We do not knowingly collect personal data directly from children under 16.

sections.heading: 11. Changes to This Policy
sections.body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Material changes will be notified via our website or by email.

sections.heading: 12. Contact Us
sections.body: For any questions about this Privacy Policy or to exercise your rights, please contact us at privacy@weartry.com.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These Terms of Service ("Terms") govern your access to and use of the WearTry website and any purchases made through it. By using our website, you agree to these Terms.

sections.heading: 1. Orders and Acceptance
sections.body: All orders are subject to acceptance and availability. We reserve the right to refuse or cancel any order at our discretion, including in cases of suspected fraud or pricing errors.

sections.heading: 2. Pricing and Payment
sections.body: All prices are displayed in the currency relevant to your selected region and include applicable VAT or sales tax where required by law. Payment is processed securely at checkout.

sections.heading: 3. Shipping
sections.body: We ship to all European Union member states, the United Kingdom and the United States. Delivery times and costs vary by destination and are shown at checkout.

sections.heading: 4. Returns and Refunds
sections.body: Please refer to our Return Policy for full details on returns, exchanges and refunds.

sections.heading: 5. Intellectual Property
sections.body: All content on this website, including text, graphics, logos and images, is the property of WearTry or its licensors and may not be used without permission.

sections.heading: 6. Limitation of Liability
sections.body: To the maximum extent permitted by law, WearTry shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental or consequential damages arising from your use of the website.

sections.heading: 7. Consumer Rights
sections.body: Nothing in these Terms affects your statutory rights as a consumer under EU, UK or US law, including your right to withdraw from a purchase within the applicable cooling-off period.

sections.heading: 8. Governing Law
sections.body: These Terms are governed by the laws applicable in your country of residence for consumer protection purposes, without prejudice to any mandatory local consumer protection laws.

sections.heading: 9. Changes to These Terms
sections.body: We may revise these Terms at any time. Continued use of the website after changes constitutes acceptance of the revised Terms.

sections.heading: 10. Contact Us
sections.body: Questions about these Terms can be sent to legal@weartry.com.

returns.title: Return & Refund Policy
returns.intro: We want you to love what you ordered. If something isn't right, here's how we make it right.

sections.heading: 1. Shipping Times
sections.body: Most orders arrive within 3–10 business days after dispatch, depending on your destination.

sections.heading: 2. Return Window
sections.body: You may request a return or exchange within 30 days of delivery, provided the item is unworn, unused and in its original packaging.

sections.heading: 3. Reporting a Problem
sections.body: If your item arrives faulty, damaged or incorrect, contact us within 14 days of delivery to open a dispute.

sections.heading: 4. How to Start a Return
sections.body: Email returns@weartry.com with your order number and, for faulty or incorrect items, photos of the issue.

sections.heading: 5. Review & Approval
sections.body: Our team reviews your request, typically within 2–3 business days, and confirms the next step — a return label, replacement, or refund.

sections.heading: 6. Refunds & Replacements
sections.body: Approved refunds are issued to your original payment method within 5–10 business days; replacements ship as soon as stock allows.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.intro: This Cookie Policy explains how WearTry uses cookies and similar technologies to recognise you when you visit our website, in line with the EU ePrivacy Directive, GDPR, and UK PECR.

sections.heading: 1. What Are Cookies
sections.body: Cookies are small data files placed on your device that help websites function properly and provide analytics and personalisation.

sections.heading: 2. Types of Cookies We Use
sections.body: Strictly necessary cookies (required for the website to function, e.g. shopping cart and checkout), performance and analytics cookies (help us understand how visitors use our site), functional cookies (remember your preferences, such as language and region), and marketing cookies (used to deliver relevant advertising).

sections.heading: 3. Your Consent
sections.body: When you first visit our website, you will be asked to accept or manage non-essential cookies. You can change your preferences at any time via the cookie settings link in the footer.

sections.heading: 4. Managing Cookies in Your Browser
sections.body: Most browsers allow you to refuse or delete cookies through their settings. Please note that blocking essential cookies may affect the functionality of our website.

sections.heading: 5. Third-Party Cookies
sections.body: Some cookies are placed by third-party services we use, such as analytics and payment providers, who have their own privacy and cookie policies.

sections.heading: 6. Changes to This Policy
sections.body: We may update this Cookie Policy periodically to reflect changes in technology or legislation.

items.question: Kuidas saan oma tellimust jälgida?
items.answer: Kui tellimus on saadetud, saad e-kirjaga jälgimislingi — kasuta seda igal ajal tarneoleku kontrollimiseks.

items.question: Kui kaua tarne aega võtab?
items.answer: Enamik tellimusi jõuab kohale 3–10 tööpäeva jooksul, olenevalt sinu asukohast.

items.question: Milline on teie tagastuspoliitika?
items.answer: Kandmata tooteid saab tagastada 30 päeva jooksul alates kättetoimetamisest — vaata kõiki üksikasju meie tagastuspoliitikast.

items.question: Milliseid makseviise aktsepteerite?
items.answer: Aktsepteerime Visa, Mastercard, American Express, PayPal, Apple Pay ja teisi suuremaid kaardivõrke.

items.question: Kuidas leian õige suuruse?
items.answer: Vaata suurustabelit iga toote lehel — mõõdud on toodud nii cm-des kui tollides.

items.question: Kas saadate rahvusvaheliselt?
items.answer: Jah, saadame üle ELi, Ühendkuningriigi ja USA ning lisame regulaarselt uusi sihtkohti.

items.question: Kas saan tellimust tühistada või muuta?
items.answer: Võta meiega ühendust mõne tunni jooksul pärast tellimuse esitamist, siis püüame selle enne saatmist uuendada või tühistada.

items.question: Kas pakute allahindluskoode?
items.answer: Liitu meie uudiskirjaga ja jälgi meie promoriba hooajaliste allahindluskoodide osas.

items.question: Millistest materjalidest on teie tooted valmistatud?
items.answer: Kasutame vastutustundlikult hangitud kangaid — vaata iga toote lehelt täpset materjali koostist.

items.question: Kuidas saan klienditoega ühendust võtta?
items.answer: Võta meie toe meeskonnaga ühendust igal ajal kontaktilehe kaudu — vastame tavaliselt 1–2 tööpäeva jooksul.
